title: paraixeris denticulata
intro: Paraixeris denticulata, commonly known as Korean mountain mint, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to provide relief from various health issues, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Korean mountain mint include reducing pain and inflammation, as well as exhibiting anti-cancer and neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include diterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
